highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: This release consolidates the full 4.147.x preview series into a stable build. It adds variable font shaping, animated WebP encoding, color font palette support, and zero-copy stream conversion. The SKObject singleton lifecycle is reworked, legacy SKPaint text APIs are promoted to errors, and default typeface resolution is corrected for Android. Check the breaking-changes section before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now uses an empty typeface instead of the lazy platform default
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText and Draw return zero/nothing. Construct with an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'unset' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: The underlying SkFont now seeds a default typeface so text still works, but null semantics changed. Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires — use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") returns Default, not null, on Android
breaking.body: Android previously returned null for unknown font families; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets and is now obsolete
breaking.body: The long overload silently truncated large offsets. It now uses a checked cast and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range value. Compiler warning CS0618 will guide migration.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 — 1.1 is now required
breaking.body: Ganesh now unconditionally acquires Vulkan 1.1 entry points; a 1.0 instance causes SK_ABORT (process termination, not an exception). Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1 AND set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same value — the default 0 is no longer safe.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the rest.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font members promoted from warnings to compile errors
breaking.body: The paint text/font members obsoleted in v3 (TextSize, Typeface, etc.) are now compile errors. Move typeface and text size onto SKFont.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete enums removed from the ref assembly
breaking.body: Enums and members that were marked [Obsolete(error: true)] in the previews are removed from the reference assembly. Update any remaining callers to the v4 replacements.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo). GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or exposes == / !=. Update construction and equality checks accordingly.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The setter for IgnorePublicDispose is no longer public. This property is lifecycle infrastructure; callers should not be setting it externally.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances through milestones 132, 133, 147, and 148, incorporating years of upstream stability work, new rendering features, and bug fixes.
SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain variable-font axis enumeration and instance selection, allowing applications to access the full design space of variable fonts.
SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP support, letting consumers encode multi-frame WebP animations directly from SkiaSharp.
A new GetData() method returns the stream contents as an SKData without an intermediate buffer copy, making stream-to-data conversion significantly cheaper.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: Both draw-surface APIs now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter for explicit control over image filtering quality.

bullets.lead: Missing API wrappers added and naming violations fixed
bullets.detail: A sweep of the binding layer added missing HarfBuzz and Skia API wrappers and corrected naming convention violations flagged by the new TreatWarningsAsErrors build.
GetPixelSpan was computing stride using Width instead of RowBytes, and the (x,y) overload used Height instead of Width for the column offset — both now use the correct values.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first fixed
bullets.detail: If an SKPathBuilder was garbage-collected before its derived SKPath, the finalizer sequence caused a native crash. The object graph and disposal order are now correct.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer
bullets.detail: Android API 36+ could return null from the native default-typeface lookup; resolution now routes through SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily with a safe Empty fallback.
The WinUI projection DLL search path was incorrect for .NET 9 consumers; the package now ships the correct reference.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView stops rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch fixed
bullets.detail: SKGLView no longer stops rendering after switching away and back to a tab in a MAUI TabBar on Android.
The creation, caching, and disposal of singleton SKObject instances (typefaces, effects, shaders) is reworked to eliminate races and ensure correct lifetime management.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi static constructor
bullets.detail: The native library compatibility check now fires in the SkiaApi static constructor rather than a module initializer, making it more reliable at load time across all host runtimes.
Library targets use versioned Apple 26.0 TFMs and app targets use the unversioned form, aligning with Apple SDK conventions for Xcode 26.
Native library assets for Linux Bionic are now included, enabling SkiaSharp use in Android-like Linux environments.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added
bullets.detail: Tizen support expands to x64 and arm64 architectures with updated Studio 6.1 tooling.
Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes are removed, reducing the build matrix and artifact size.
expat updated to 2.8.1, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font and color palette support, HarfBuzz and Skia binding improvements, singleton lifecycle rework, Linux Bionic and Tizen platform additions, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets and contributed HarfBuzz platform improvements
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar on Android

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 finalized the release by landing the m148 engine update, the singleton lifecycle rework, SKPixmap stride and offset fixes, legacy SKPaint API errors, the WinUI .NET 9 fix, expat update, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added the HBColor struct, missing API wrappers, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, and zlib updates, and dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM builds.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer fix, Apple 26.0 TFM updates, and Skottie sample fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132/m133/m147 milestone chain, variable font and color palette support, SKSamplingOptions overloads, Linux Bionic, Tizen x64/arm64, and the Android MAUI TabBar fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 with variable font axis support, color palette APIs (HBColor), Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 platform additions, and a Warnings-as-Errors binding cleanup pass.
